blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines commemorated the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law on Monday, Sept. 21, but a data scientist pointed out, based on a recent international assessment, that more than five decades since Proclamation No. 1081, “post-martial law safeguards continue to fail.” “More than four decades after the restoration of democracy, have democratic institutions in the Philippines become stronger?” asked Dr. Alicor Panao, an associate professor at the University of the Philippines, as he discussed in an analysis an assessment by the Varieties of Democracy Institute.
